response: Telmisartan may help reduce hepatic fibrosis in rats with alloxan-induced diabetes. According to the available data, telmisartan has been shown to reduce type-I diabetes mellitus-induced hepatic injury by suppressing activated hepatic stellate cells through concomitant TGF-beta1 down-regulation. This suggests that telmisartan may have a protective effect against hepatic fibrosis in diabetic rats. However, more research may be needed to fully understand the mechanisms and potential benefits of telmisartan in preventing hepatic fibrosis.
